objective: Complete the missing/inadequately-coded production process steps (duration enforcement, storyboard structure, render-unit supersession, slotting, real generation adapter, assembly richness, cost tracking) BEFORE any further paid provider call.

requirements.title: Deterministic script-duration compliance
requirements.statement: The pipeline must refuse a script whose estimated narration duration exceeds the format target range, via a programmatic gate (not prompt text alone). Format word budgets must be calibrated to the actual James voice pace (~60-74 wpm).
requirements.rationale: Real run produced a 195-word/198s script for a 75s teaser; LLM reviewers passed it (2.6x over).

requirements.title: Canonical, band-compliant storyboard shot mix
requirements.statement: DB-produced storyboards must assign shot types in the canonical vocabulary (hero_lipsync / broll_* / graphic_*) in a distribution satisfying review_storyboard bands; never a uniform talking-head fallback.
requirements.rationale: All 4 beats of the real storyboard were talking_head_standard; the hero/b-roll/graphic mix never materialized.

requirements.title: Render-unit supersession on invalidation (D-015)
requirements.statement: Re-running compile_media after invalidation must supersede prior render units; consumers see exactly one active set per plan revision.
requirements.rationale: D-015 open: re-compile appended a second unit set (8 units vs 4), doubling the timeline.

requirements.title: Multi-clip slotting of long beats
requirements.statement: Beats longer than the max clip length must be broken into <=max-clip slots; hero slots carry their master-narration audio slice.
requirements.rationale: compile_media passed one slot per beat; a 30s hero beat was never split -> coverage gaps. Hidden by S8's short fixture + FakeProvider.

requirements.title: Real generation request enrichment (Q-001)
requirements.statement: A Higgsfield generation request must carry a real per-clip prompt, the hero reference image (--image), and the hero master-narration slice (--audio for seedance_2_0).
requirements.rationale: Request payload was {asset_type,model,duration_ms,audio_policy}; prompt defaulted to 'educational video'; no lipsync audio or reference image.

requirements.title: Assembly richness: graphics + music bed
requirements.statement: The assembled output must include graphics and a music bed in addition to the clip bed + master narration.
requirements.rationale: User wants both; build_assembly_manifest currently emits clips + master narration only.

requirements.title: Paid-call cost tracking
requirements.statement: Every paid call (TTS + generation) must write a cost_events row so spend is auditable against the cap.
requirements.rationale: invoke_tts records no cost_events; ~$0.90 spent is not in the ledger.

requirements.title: Test isolation / order-independence
requirements.statement: The suite must be order-independent: no test module sets PRODUCTION_DB_PATH (or any DB env) at module-import scope; every test's DB identity is per-test only.
requirements.rationale: test_produce_db_orchestrator.py:19 sets PRODUCTION_DB_PATH at module level (the only such case; all others use fixture-scoped setenv+del). It breaks isolation: the s8_resume e2e fails (No active timeline spans) only when run after the orchestrator test, passes alone. Pre-existing at 3f1c9fa.

requirements.title: Test hermeticity — no unmocked external LLM/web calls
requirements.statement: No test may reach a real kiro-cli (or other external LLM/web) call in YT_TEST_MODE; the suite must run green to completion with kiro-cli unavailable. Tests verify the real logic directly (not via the full external-call path).
requirements.rationale: research.py:262-266 runs a real kiro-cli subprocess with no YT_TEST_MODE guard (unlike D-013 for TTS). test_research_sources.py drives it with dry_run=False + mocked search but unmocked LLM; it hangs environmentally and timeout_method=thread cannot recover, stalling the whole suite. Reproduces at baseline 3f1c9fa. Blocks the sprint's full-suite-green validation gate.

invariants.title: No-hacks rule: root cause in pipeline code
Gate binding (SHA-256), two human gates, no --force-unsafe
Lipsync non-negotiable: hero must lipsync or hard-fail; baked audio verbatim (-map 0:a)
Financial rule: no paid call until Wave 3 + user gate_a_spend re-approval; $5 cap

defects.title: Storyboard uniform talking-head (role discarded, wrong vocab)
Long beats not slotted into <=clip-length units
Real provider adapter never exercised with a real request
TTS paid call not recorded in cost_events
Module-level PRODUCTION_DB_PATH override breaks test isolation (order-dependent e2e failure)
Unmocked kiro-cli call in research tests stalls the suite when kiro-cli is unavailable

risks.title: Generation adapter correctness on the paid path
risks.note: Verify with --dry-run/mocks before any paid call; image+audio provenance must satisfy lipsync invariants.

risks.title: Storyboard vocabulary reconciliation design choice
risks.note: direct_storyboard.py route vs deterministic assignment; couples visual_intent into S9-C06.

risks.title: Slotting/slicing coverage + audio-sync correctness
risks.note: Slice must match slot timing and assembly provenance hash.
